text: The absence of any statistically significant effect of mandatory disclosure on hedge fund returns suggests that the transparency costs associated with disclosure do not significantly affect the profitability of hedge fund advisers.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Barbara Luppi, Sandra Paterlini, Did the Dodd-Frank Act Impact Private Fund Performance  – Evidence from 2010 – 2015 (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2816408
